statement: WITH channels AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(channel_id AS STRING) AS channel_id FROM prod_tads.youtube_too.yt_sl_channels WHERE channel_id IS NOT NULL), raw_categories AS (SELECT CAST(canonical_id AS STRING) AS channel_id, topic_categories, collected_at, collected_date FROM dev_sean.default.channel_category WHERE canonical_id IS NOT NULL), latest AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_categories, collected_at, collected_date FROM (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.channel_id ORDER BY r.collected_at DESC, r.collected_date DESC) AS rn FROM raw_categories r INNER JOIN channels c ON r.channel_id = c.channel_id) WHERE rn = 1), exploded AS (SELECT l.channel_id, cat AS topic_category_url, CASE WHEN cat RLIKE '/wiki/' THEN regexp_replace(regexp_extract(cat, '/wiki/(.*)$', 1), '%20', '_') ELSE cat END AS topic_category FROM latest l LATERAL VIEW explode(array_distinct(filter(coalesce(l.topic_categories, CAST(array() AS ARRAY<STRING>)), x -> x IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(x)) > 0))) e AS cat), freq AS (SELECT topic_category, topic_category_url, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_channels FROM exploded GROUP BY topic_category, topic_category_url), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_channels_total FROM channels) SELECT topic_category, topic_category_url, n_channels, n_channels_total, ROUND(100.0 * n_channels / n_channels_total, 4) AS pct_channels FROM freq CROSS JOIN totals ORDER BY n_channels DESC, topic_category ASC
